The slice creates a new canonical contract, core/contracts/behavioral-eval.schema.json (BehavioralEvalRecord, version 1.0.0), which is a CONTRACT_RECORD under this repository's adopted relevance classes: a new machine-readable canonical record surface that downstream consumers validate against. The contract and validator are analysis and evidence surfaces only: an eval record gates release quality evidence for an evaluated subject but grants no permission, promotes no skill, activates no runtime, and replaces no approval decision; live-model runs are isolated by construction (allowed_effects = [], no inherited qualification, no workspace writes) or refuse fail-closed. The required Registry write is the CONTRACT_RECORD projection of the new schema plus this run's change registration; it is blocked only by sequencing (the Registry pull request follows this repository's merge) and is not blocked by any open question about the classification itself. The disposition is rebound to UPDATED with registry_commit_sha in the follow-up owner evidence update once the Registry write has merged.
